body_markdown:
[Back to Blog](https://www.aepenergy.com/blog)


As fall approaches, small business owners have a valuable opportunity to get ahead of rising energy costs. Natural gas prices can spike up to 30% during peak winter months due to increased heating demand. Choosing a fixed-rate plan now helps you avoid seasonal price hikes and keeps your budget predictable.


**Why Natural Gas?**
Natural gas is an efficient, cost-effective energy choice option. Its reliability makes it an ideal solution for businesses that depend on consistent energy performance throughout the year.


**Why Secure a Rate Now?**
For businesses, seasonal price spikes can lead to unpredictable and higher energy bills, especially during extreme weather events. Locking in a fixed rate now helps you stabilize monthly energy expenses and protect your budget from market volatility. By acting early, you gain control over one of your most essential operating costs before demand drives prices up.


**How Your Business Benefits**
No matter what type of business you run, energy costs are a significant part of your overhead. A fixed-rate natural gas plan offers budget predictability, peace of mind during peak heating season, and flexible contract options tailored to your operational needs.


**Here’s How You Can Get Started**
It’s never too early to think about securing your natural gas rate. You can begin by:


1. Reviewing your current usage
2. Exploring AEP Energy’s fixed-rate natural gas plans
3. Speaking with a Small Business Energy Consultant at 1-877-648-1936
4. Choosing a plan that aligns with your business goals


Securing a fixed natural gas rate is a proactive step toward protecting your business from seasonal price swings and market uncertainty. AEP Energy is a trusted energy supplier, offering a competitive[Single Rate Plan for Natural Gas](https://www.aepenergy.com/small-business/request-a-sbs-quote/) to Ohio businesses. Our team of Small Business Energy Consultants are ready to help you make informed decisions and find a plan that fits your business needs.


If you’re already an AEP Energy natural gas customer, contact our Account Management team at 1-888-924-7111 to review your natural gas agreement and explore renewal options.
